title: Fun, active, experience close to Granada
text:
My whole family (including my 2 teens) loved this experience so much! Angela was very responsive from the start, confirming right away and asking and answering questions.  She is kind and very knowledgeable.  Kira, her sweet, calm dog was great fun to have on this hike.  My children loved have Kira with us.  Angela drove all of us in her van, a 20-minute drive away from  the heat of Granada into the hills, where the temperature was perfect mid-70s (in July!), a bit chilly even at the end, a refreshing change from the scorching temperatures in Granada.
